title: Exact dirty-fanout source counts over finite associative rings
body:
This enabling proof extends the finite-commutative source-count criterion to every finite associative unital ring. The minimum is zero for zero demand, one for a nonzero principal left demand ideal, and two otherwise. It gives restoring constructions and a noncommutative left-versus-right ideal discriminator. The complete kappa calculation is unchanged.

[Proof and scope](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/77fef394048539d269a45433f30a064d34af96a9/research/finite-ring-source-insertions/README.md), [exact checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/77fef394048539d269a45433f30a064d34af96a9/research/finite-ring-source-insertions/verify.py), [replay declaration](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/77fef394048539d269a45433f30a064d34af96a9/research/finite-ring-source-insertions/VERIFY.json), and [source provenance](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/77fef394048539d269a45433f30a064d34af96a9/research/finite-ring-source-insertions/SOURCES.json) are pinned to the reviewed commit. Base: canonical main `ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf`, priority revision 7.

The initial proof and standalone check are in [Discussion #5300](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5300).

CPython 3.12.14 registered normal and optimized replays passed: 1,825 demand lists across six ring/row contexts, including 120 nonprincipal demands and 38 elementary source orbits. Both print `PASS_FINITE_RING_INSERTIONS`; the launcher prints `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`. All five package files match their committed bytes, and the base is an ancestor of the package commit.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/finite-ring-source-insertions
```

Use Python 3.12 and the standard library. No external runtime inputs or third-party Python packages are required. Hosted planning and the registered package replay passed on this exact head in [run 39990770611](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39990770611). No predecessor scientific suite, selected cold replay, native replay, compiler, Lean or Docker build was run. The optional full-history preflight is unavailable in this shallow checkout. Finite checks corroborate the written proof; they do not constitute independent human or proof-kernel acceptance.

Price one concrete noncommutative realization, including native coefficients and movement. Source preparation, native operations, precision, movement, and supplier/outer admission remain separate obligations.

Credit lee-phys's [PR #5139](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5139) and [pinned finite-commutative proof](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf/research/finite-commutative-fanout/README.md), Nick Petalas's [PR #4916](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4916) and [noncommutative gate contract](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf/research/unit-ring-dirty-fanout/README.md), Ross Richardson's [PR #3121](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3121), and Ali Romman's [Discussion #5266](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5266) and [Discussion #5269](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5269). Their ideal invariant, restoring echo, matrix-ring case and model retain their credit. No general ring-theory priority is claimed.

Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.
